assertions.paraphrase: Retrospective statistical and geospatial analyses connect physical/hydraulic predictors to mussel distribution.
assertions.limit: Exploratory associations and predictions; not evidence of an experimental restoration effect.

assertions.paraphrase: Low-flow transport and high-flow hydraulic refuge are proposed explanations for hydraulic associations with mussel density.
assertions.limit: Specific retrospective reach/flow context; no universal numerical design threshold extracted.

assertions.paraphrase: Repeated tagged-mussel measurements show species/time/habitat variation in survival and growth; substrate stability is relevant to interpretation.
assertions.limit: Do not infer that a Steamboat intervention caused survival changes.

assertions.paraphrase: Core-to-periphery source-sink dynamics are proposed, with further recruitment-source studies needed.
assertions.limit: Proposed explanation is not a confirmed population mechanism.

assertions.paraphrase: Recruitment strength is associated with discharge metrics, with different selected predictors for life-history groups.
assertions.limit: Species/life-history and retrospective cohort scope retained; no transferred coefficients or universal threshold.

assertions.paraphrase: Literature and expert-derived biological parameter estimates enter HEA scenarios; sensitivity analysis exposes uncertainty in restoration-scaling outputs.
assertions.source_locator: Early-view PDF pp3-4 Parameterization; p6 Sensitivity Analysis; p8 Data Needed
assertions.limit: Selected text sections only; no table-cell values transcribed and no claim HEA was used for Steamboat.

assertions.paraphrase: A shared UMRS model distinguishes connected channel, off-channel and floodplain systems and controlling variables across scales.
assertions.limit: System context; not a mussel-specific restoration-effect study.

assertions.paraphrase: A proposed restoration intervention maintaining suitable substrate stability across relevant flows may improve local conditions for mussel persistence.
assertions.limit: Not a verbatim author hypothesis or demonstrated treatment effect. Requires applicability review and local design/observation evidence.
